title: Fine-tuning for image-to-PlantUML: Qwen3.5 at 2B, 9B and 27B
description:
Qwen3.5-2B, 9B and 27B are fine-tuned with one fixed LoRA recipe on 20,000 rendered real-world PlantUML diagrams, and the published image-to-PlantUML benchmark is run before and after on its 1,000 test diagrams, each size against itself.

The release holds the code, the frozen key lists, every test-set and dev-set run with its scores, and the tables; the adapters are on Hugging Face.
